note: An example of TALOS_HOME/config/owner.json (talos.personal): who you are to Talos. id is the name your own decisions are stored under (keep it once chosen); name is how a record calls you when Jev reads mail you sent; service_prefix names the background services (<prefix>.sync, .web, .teams); sent_by_key is the record's flag for mail you sent.
